Results attained under output 1: - Twenty (20) Programme Implementation Action Plans (PIAPs) are being implemented at National level - Twenty (20) Programme Implementation Action Plans (PIAPs) were reviewed in 2022 during the NDP3 MTR process. - One (1) digital platform completed to Certificate of Compliance (COC) in alignment of planning and budget frameworks.
Results attained under output 2: -Development and Validation of the Public Investment Financing Strategy (PIFS) accomplished on 14th March 2022. -Public Investment Financing Strategy (PIFS) finalized. Waiting for the launch.
Results attained under output 3 - 119 out of 201 SDG indicators applicable to Uganda have data points (SDG indicators with reportable data). - Two (2) SDG related reports (1: UNDP, UNWOMEN and UNFPA JP on data and statistics and 1 SDG progress report); SDGs Progress Report 2022; GAPR 2022; CoC.
Results attained under output 4 - Supported the production of 3 reports (SDG progress report 2021; Multidimensional poverty index report 2020; and Poverty status report 2021) at national level and 4 reports at UNDP level. - Draft AfCFTA implementation strategy; Cost of Credit Report; APEX Report on commercialization of agriculture. - One (1) national SDG conference and 3 regional SDG conference (Statcom8; Abuja; Pretoria; AEC) were held with support form UNDP and other DPs in 2022
